title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter full trip/party amounts in euros (€) consistently; no flight, hotel, meal, fare, ticket, or reimbursement amount has been assumed. Bus and travel-card prices are now published and verified on the transport page if you want a benchmark for the transport rows; the only hotel-side figure with an official basis is the €1.50-per-night eco-contribution for guests aged 18+.

records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Optional line only for charges separately shown on the confirmed hotel invoice. The 2026 MTA guideline PDF lists €1.50 per night for each guest aged 18+ at the start of the visit, capped at €22.50 per person per visit, and separately disclosed on a fiscal receipt. The MTA webpage also has a “15-Night Threshold” sentence about charges on nights exceeding fifteen; the two official texts are not clearly reconciled for a short stay. If six nights are billable under the PDF’s per-night rule, €9 per eligible adult is conditional arithmetic only, not the traveler’s confirmed amount. Do not duplicate charges already in the accommodation total.
records.notes: The 2026 MTA guidelines PDF read 11 October states the nightly rate, age test, €22.50 cap and separate receipt disclosure: https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . The MTA service page was also read directly 11 October and separately says charges apply to nights that “exceeded fifteen (15) nights”: https://mta.com.mt/services/environmental-contribution/ . Do not infer how that wording applies to a short stay; see OQ-23/OQ-25 and ask AX ODYCY/MTA. The six-night calculation is conditional only. Actual billable nights, guest ages and invoice amount are unknown; nothing is prefilled.
records.price range: MTA guideline: €1.50 per night per eligible guest, cap €22.50 per person; short-stay treatment of the MTA webpage’s 15-night wording remains open. €9 for six billable nights is conditional arithmetic only.

records.name: Local buses / travel cards
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the total for the travel card or individual bus fares actually planned. Two published prices are usable for planning: the €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day card, or a €2.50 day-route single as a planning inference. Buying a card removes the single-fare uncertainty for a multi-day stay, which suits this trip.
records.notes: Fare page read in full 11 October 2026: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/. It dates its €2.00 winter single to 19 October 2025 – 13 June 2026, which ends before this trip, and prints no 2026/27 changeover date, so €2.50 is a planning inference rather than a published trip-week fare. Card terms are clear: €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day includes Day, Night, Airport Direct and Special Services; the cheaper-looking €25 Explore Adult card EXCLUDES tallinja Direct routes, so it would not cover the TD1 airport line — the €2 dearer card is the better buy if you want the airport bus. €19 buys 12 shareable Single Day Journeys valid 6 months. €50 fine for travelling without a valid ticket. Cards are sold at Buġibba Terminal, the airport, Valletta Terminal and Sliema Ferries. See getting-around.html#mpt-fares-cards and transport record mpt-seasonal-fare-window-2026.
records.price range: Not set; check current fares and card conditions

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to the confirmed MFCC/BLAST Arena Studios entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.description: Track the event-day commute separately from general bus spending. The venue is confirmed and the outbound leg is workable: Route 186 from Qawra reaches the Ta' Qali Stadium stop in time for the published 09:30 check-in. The return is the uncertain leg — on the three dates with a visible agenda the listed finish (21:00–22:30) is later than the 20:53 departure in the one static Route 186 variant checked, so budget a taxi or ride-hailing return in the taxi-rideshare row unless the date-specific planner shows a suitable bus. Enter the bus amount once you have chosen a card or know the single fare you will pay.
records.notes: Published venue days from the event's ticketing page: 09:30 check-in / 10:30 games / to 22:30 on Wed 14 and Thu 15 October, and 14:00 / 15:00 / to 21:00 on Fri 16 October; Sat 17 and Sun 18 were not visible. That comparison flags a risk from one static variant; it is not a complete network search, so run MPT's date-specific planner for all routes and the confirmed gate. MPT also lists evening Route 186 diversion notices affecting the return direction. One thing to watch rather than plan on: MPT runs TQ-numbered special event services out of Ta' Qali, and TQ1's corridor runs through St Paul's Bay and Qawra to Buġibba at the €3.00 Special Services fare — its page showed 'Timetable not available!' when checked and no TWC notice was found, so check https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ daily during 14–18 October. See getting-around.html#event-checklist and OQ-H3.
records.price range: Not set; exact date/time route and event return are not confirmed

records.name: Taxi / ride-hailing — likely event-night returns
records.address: Not applicable — enter only trips you plan to take
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: The realistic fallback for event nights: on the three dates with a visible agenda the listed finish is later than the one published Route 186 return departure checked, and that return does not list a Qawra stop. Budget one return per event day unless the date-specific planner shows a suitable bus. Quotes, availability and pickup location are trip-specific and prices are dynamic, so enter actual amounts from live quotes rather than planning from a cap.
records.notes: As a ceiling for a metered taxi, Transport Malta publishes maximum rates — but the page footer states 'Page last updated: 06/04/2022', so treat them as possibly revised: https://www.transport.gov.mt/land/public-transport/other-public-transport/taxis-829. From those bands a capped fare works out around €12.40 for 5 km, €19.40 for 10 km, €25.90 for 15 km and €30.90 for 20 km — this guide's arithmetic at assumed distances, excluding waiting (€25/hour) and traffic (€4.20/hour) charges, and NOT a quote. The road distance from AX ODYCY to the venue was never measured. Ride-hailing is dynamic and not bound by the meter tariff, so compare a live Bolt/eCabs/Uber quote against the cap. Pre-book rather than rely on hailing: no taxi rank at an inland studio was verified, and demand is likely to spike when an audience leaves at once. See OQ-H7.
records.price range: Live quote varies; no amount prefilled

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: Hotspawn’s Eventbrite listing, read 11 October, advertised 14–18 October. Visible agenda rows: Wed 14 check-in 09:30 / games 10:30 and Thu 15 check-in 09:30 / games 10:30, each running through 22:30; Fri 16 check-in 14:00 / games 15:00, running through 21:00. The listing headline says 09:30–22:00; confirm the Wed/Thu finish-time discrepancy. Sat/Sun agenda entries were not visible in the extracted page. The listing marked the event in-person and 18+.
records.description: If attending, enter only a confirmed ticket amount (if any) and actual quoted or paid event-related transport, food, or merchandise costs when known. The listing read 11 October advertised “Free / Reserve a spot” for in-person 18+ attendance; this does not confirm current inventory, this traveler’s reservation, attendee-gate instructions, per-day validity/scanning, or that a zero personal admission expense is appropriate. No event attendance, ticket, ride, meal, or merchandise spend is assumed; leave budget and actual amounts blank until itinerary/booking details are supplied.
records.notes: Read 11 October 2026: the Hotspawn Eventbrite listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 displayed BLAST Arena Studios Malta / MFCC South Gate National Stadium / ATD 4000 Attard, dates 14–18 October, an in-person 18+ audience, and a free “Reserve a spot” action. Agenda entries for 14–16 October were visible; the Saturday/Sunday entries were not visible in the extracted page, and the listing headline’s 22:00 conflicts with the Wednesday/Thursday rows extending to 22:30. Its attendee gate, current inventory, this traveler’s reservation, ticket transferability and per-day validity/scanning remain unverified; the FAQ answers were not readable in the extraction. HLTV also reported a free-ticket listing and linked to Eventbrite: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Thunderpick’s organizer page gives the wider 12–19 October operational window: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . The Thunderpick-issued release names BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html . These sources describe the listing/event, not the traveler’s booking or actual cost. Enter amounts only after the user supplies confirmed ticket, itinerary, or quotes. Two budget-relevant unknowns remain: whether one registration covers all five days or each day needs its own, and whether there is on-site parking (which would bear on whether car hire is viable on event days). All nine ticketing-page FAQ answers are client-side and did not render, so neither is answered here — see OQ-H2 as logged on main. No ticket has been secured by this project.
records.price range: Unknown for this traveler. The listing read 11 October advertised a free “Reserve a spot” option; current availability and reservation status are not established. Leave planner amounts blank until confirmed.
